To perform the analytical calculations on the provided dataset, let's first parse the data into a DataFrame and then compute the necessary KPIs along with the categorical analysis and correlations.

Below is a Python script to do so:

```python
import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

# Load data into a DataFrame
data = """Order_ID,Customer_ID,Customer_Name,Order_Date,Product,Category,Region,City,Payment_Mode,Order_Status,Quantity,Price,Discount (%),Shipping_Cost,Total_Sales,Discount_Amount,Profit
1,1051,Rahul Verma,2024-01-01,Headphones,Accessories,North,Delhi,Credit Card,Delivered,2,1868,13,111,3736,485.68,3139.32
2,1092,Karan Gupta,2024-01-02,Laptop,Electronics,West,Chennai,Debit Card,Shipped,9,347,19,47,3123,593.37,2482.63
... (The full dataset as shown in your input)
380,1098,Meera Sharma,2025-01-14,Headphones,Accessories,North,Delhi,Credit Card,Shipped,8,1291,6,66,10328,619.68,9642.32"""
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Initialize the output structure
output = {}

# Real KPIs
for col in df.select_dtypes(include='number').columns:
    output[f"{col}_sum"] = round(df[col].sum(), 2)
    output[f"{col}_avg"] = round(df[col].mean(), 2)
    output[f"{col}_max"] = round(df[col].max(), 2)
    output[f"{col}_min"] = round(df[col].min(), 2)

# Category counts for categorical columns
for col in df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns:
    counts = df[col].value_counts().head(6).to_dict()
    output[f"{col}_counts"] = counts

# Correlations among numerical columns
corr = df.select_dtypes(include='number').corr()
output["correlations"] = corr.round(2).to_dict()

# Print the results
import json
print(json.dumps(output, indent=2))
```

Replace the `...(The full dataset as shown in your input)` with the actual data rows you provided. The script will read the dataset, calculate sums, averages, minimums, maximums for numerical columns, count distinct values for categorical columns, and compute the correlation matrix for numerical columns.

This script will provide you with a JSON-formatted output containing all the computed KPIs, category distribution, and correlations, ready to be reviewed or used in further analysis or reporting.
